about: [C4] Proof 3 of WAVE_C §7 for II The Fight: a player who uses what was taught (reads the dodge cue and slips toward the light, punishes the opening with a loaded punch, jabs the side he drops, blocks his jab, takes what is slid to him, finishes with a loaded punch: tools/lib/fight_bot.mjs 'good') wins, and wins again (the fight begun again from its lesson beat, as a chapter retry), each in two to three minutes. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/fight_good.json

steps.label: [C4] the taught player wins twice in a row, each fight (the lesson in it) under three minutes and a bit, down once at most
